pages.title: Review problem - 1
pages.content:
Chef Two and Chef Ten are playing a game with a number $X$. \
In one turn, they can multiply $X$ by $2$. \
The goal of the game is to make $X$ divisible by $10$.

Help the Chefs find the smallest number of turns necessary to win the game (it may be possible to win in zero turns) or determine that it is impossible.

callout.title: Key idea
callout.text: Focus on review problem - 1: trace the data flow, state changes, and edge conditions before coding.

checkpoint.question: Which Euclidean-algorithm property makes GCD computation efficient?
checkpoint.explanation: This choice directly supports systematic problem solving and reliable debugging.

pages.title: Review problem - 2
pages.content:
You have $N$ balls and $K$ boxes. You want to divide the $N$ balls into $K$ boxes such that: 
- Each box contains $\ge 1$ balls.
- No two boxes contain the same number of balls.

Determine if it is possible to do so.
